name: Drawer
summary: Drawer. A perceivable feedback primitive with focus, announcement, and reduced-motion behavior.

lifecycle.compatibility: Available for controlled production evaluation; the contract may still be refined.
lifecycle.rationale: The modal side-surface contract remains beta while placement, nested overlays, and manual assistive-technology evidence are completed.
knownLimitations: There is no public typed imperative overlay service in the current release.
Consumers must verify narrow-layout fallback and safe content width with production forms.
promotionCriteria: Public API, defaults, aliases and entrypoint ownership are reviewed.
SSR/hydration, keyboard, accessibility and visual evidence are linked.
Runtime scale limits and consumer testing contract are documented.
Migration impact is classified before lifecycle promotion.

api.name: open
api.description: Controls whether the disclosure or overlay surface is visible.

api.name: modal
api.description: Blocks background interaction and traps focus while the drawer is open.

api.name: size
api.description: Selects the drawer thickness along its entry edge.

api.name: side
api.description: Chooses the physical or logical viewport edge from which the drawer enters.

api.name: title
api.description: Visible title that also names the component surface or data view.

api.name: description
api.description: Visible supporting description for the component content.

api.name: eyebrow
api.description: Human-readable copy for the eyebrow state or control.

api.name: ariaLabel
api.description: Accessible name used when visible content is not sufficient.

api.name: showClose
api.description: Controls whether the component applies the show close behavior.

api.name: closeLabel
api.description: Human-readable copy for the close state or control.

api.name: closeOnEscape
api.description: Allows Escape to dismiss the topmost owned overlay.

api.name: closeOnOutside
api.description: Allows an interaction outside the owned overlay to dismiss it.

api.name: initialFocus
api.description: Identifies the element that receives focus when the modal surface opens.

api.name: restoreFocus
api.description: Explicit focus return target, or `false` to disable focus restoration.

api.name: contentTemplate
api.description: Template used to render the component body with its typed context.

api.name: actionsTemplate
api.description: Template used to render product-owned actions in the designated slot.

api.name: closed
api.description: Notifies the consumer after the closed interaction completes.

api.name: afterExited
api.description: Emits after exit motion and global modal cleanup have completed.

keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the open drawer.
Escape closes the topmost dismissible drawer.
Focus returns to the drawer opener.
notes: The drawer exposes modal dialog semantics and a visible title.
Logical start/end placement remains correct in LTR and RTL.
Nested overlays preserve deterministic Escape ordering and focus restoration.
KERN avoids ambient browser globals in reusable runtime infrastructure.
Validate the consuming SSR/hydration route, locale, ids and overlay host.

examples.title: Controlled details drawer

guidance.useWhen: Use Drawer for a focused modal workflow whose spatial relationship is naturally anchored to a viewport side.
guidance.avoidWhen: Do not use a modal Drawer as permanent application navigation; use Sidebar or Navigation Rail.

commonMistakes: Importing from an undeclared family path or a source implementation file.
Loading only tokens.css instead of the complete styles/kern.css component bundle.
Assuming the documentation SSR build replaces validation of the consuming application.
Do not use a modal Drawer for persistent page navigation.
checklist: Import the symbol from its documented owner entrypoint; do not use a deep source import.
Load @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css exactly once in the application's global styles.
Provide every required input and keep collection identities stable across updates.
Verify keyboard, focus, visible labels, invalid state, long text, RTL and 200% zoom.
Test the consuming SSR/hydration route when server rendering is enabled.
Use @kern-ui/angular/testing harnesses when a component-specific harness is available.

controls.label: Size

controls.label: Modal

controls.label: Outside click
controls.description: Inherits the surface policy by default, or explicitly enables or disables outside-click closing.

fixtureEffect.label: long text

exclusions.reason: Template inputs require a compiled Angular fixture and cannot be represented by a scalar URL-safe control.
Low-value duplicate accessibility copy is validated by the a11y fixture and kept stable while visual parameters change.
This localizable action label is stable accessibility copy; interaction/state controls exercise the same component behavior without duplicating every locale string.
Template inputs require a compiled Angular fixture and cannot be represented by a scalar URL-safe control.
DOM identity/focus wiring must stay deterministic so labels, overlays, and hydration references remain valid.
The public type is not a lossless scalar/literal contract and requires a typed specimen fixture.
